# simplemdm_push_certificate (Data Source)

Retrieves information about the Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) certificate for your SimpleMDM account. This is useful for monitoring certificate expiration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplemdm_push_certificate" "current" {}

output "certificate_expires_at" {
  value = data.simplemdm_push_certificate.current.expires_at
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A static identifier for this data source (always 'push_certificate').
- `apple_id` (String) The Apple ID associated with the push certificate.
- `expires_at` (String) The expiration date and time of the push certificate.
- `subject` (String) The certificate subject string.
